description: Answers which dftracer annotation macro or call to use (init/fini, function, metadata, update) per language, and checks a snippet with dftracer_annotate_api_check.
instructions: Look the API up with dftracer_get_init_fini / dftracer_get_function_annotations / dftracer_get_metadata_api / dftracer_get_function_update_api, then check any code you wrote with dftracer_annotate_api_check(language, code).
